verdict.rationale: JumpCloud's own pages describe JumpCloud Go as a hardware-protected, phishing-resistant passwordless login method for web resources. The MFA page also lists the JumpCloud Protect authenticator app, biometrics and hardware keys as supported methods. The core of passwordless sign-in is therefore a first-party, documented capability, though the evidence is marketing-level and Go is scoped to managed devices. Missing for 10: explicit passkey/FIDO2 passwordless support, in-depth setup documentation beyond marketing pages, passwordless coverage beyond managed devices and web resources, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
